data.long_meaning: Guzeen is an Arabic name for girls, meaning 'Pure, Clean'. It is derived from the root 'Ghaz' which connotes purity and cleanliness. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Guzeen usually hope their child will grow to embody pure, clean and live with faith, good character and purpose.
